description: This file defines the SerialIoStream class, which implements the IoStream interface for serial port communication. It manages opening, closing, writing, purging, and listening to serial port data, utilizing the jssc.SerialPort library and integrating with a logger and data listener.

classes.name: SerialIoStream
classes.description: Implements IoStream interface to facilitate serial port I/O operations, including data transmission, port management, and event listening.

methods.name: SerialIoStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing SerialIoStream with a SerialPort and Logger.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port, logging the operation and handling exceptions.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends bytes over the serial port, with exception handling.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears the serial port buffers and handles errors.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a DataListener to handle incoming serial data, attaching event listeners.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns the current closed state of the serial port.
